content:
maya: quick thread for runtime Q&A follow-ups — pulling items from today's all-hands.
liam: thanks, Maya.
sandra: scheduler refactor ship window? slide said 'next quarter' 3 can we tighten that up?
carlos: target: internal canary mid-April, broader canary late-April, general rollout May. still fixing a tail latency regression.
jen: what regression pattern? p95/p99 or throughput?
carlos: tail p95 for short sequences when microbatch packing misaligns; throughput generally fine.
ashley: can you paste a tiny repro log for local sims?
carlos: snippet:
2026-04-10T09:21:02Z serve WARN batch_scheduler.cpp:198 - dropped_batch_count=3 max_batch=32 got=36
2026-04-10T09:21:02Z runtime INFO kernel_scheduler.cpp:57 - microbatch_assignments=[4,4,4,4,4,6]
noah: is this on optimized-kernels branch?
carlos: yes.
liam: will rollout be per-pool opt-in or global flip?
maya: per-pool opt-in for Dedicated/Private; hosted staged with automatic fallback on SLO breaches.
sandra: can Console simulate expected cost/latency delta before applying changes?
ashley: yes  we plan a simulation view using historical traces and show p50/p95 and token-cost delta.
carlos: devs please run the perf harness: tools/perf/harness `--model llama-13b --seq-distribution short --canary`. README updated.
noah: can the harness emit a machine-detectable canary marker for CI?
carlos: adding `--canary` flag this week.
jen: KV cache semantics: any change to eviction behavior?
carlos: default stays LRU by capacity; adding optional TTL plugin for customers who prefer time-based expiry.
liam: rollback triggers? if p99 increases >5% for customers, do we auto-rollback?
maya: hosted has default auto-fallback thresholds; Dedicated/Private can opt into auto-rollback.
sandra: can Product publish recommended SLO thresholds for chat vs embeddings?
maya: yes  targeted doc next week.
deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: kernel-scheduler-v2 -> canary pools (mid-April). See /deploys/198 for details.
liam: propose 20m follow-up with eng-runtime to walk through checklist and canary plan.
maya: booked Tue 10am PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:
